summary.text: On November 7, 2025, Jefferson described AI's potential to speed up workers' tasks and called labor disruption a real risk. On May 27, 2026, Jefferson expressed optimism about AI's promise for productivity and growth while monitoring its effects on the labor market and inflation. On October 1, 2026, Jefferson said AI-related spending was supporting strong business investment and expected AI-related investments to continue supporting growth that year.
